**Classic Lasagna Ingredients** | Category | Typical Items | |----------|---------------| | **Lasagna Noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | 1 lb ground beef or a mix of beef & pork; 1 small onion (chopped); 2–3 cloves garlic (minced); 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce; 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste; 1 cup beef or vegetable broth; 1 tsp dried oregano; 1 tsp dried basil; ½ tsp salt; ¼ tsp black pepper; pinch of red‑pepper flakes (optional) | | **Ricotta Mixture** | 15 oz ricotta cheese; 1 egg; ½ cup grated Parmesan; 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley or 1 tsp dried Italian seasoning; pinch of nutmeg (optional) | | **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (part‑moist or part‑shelf) | | **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated (for topping) | | **Optional Extras** | • Sautéed spinach or kale (½–1 cup)
• Sliced mushrooms (½ cup)
• Red bell pepper (½ cup, diced)
• Fresh basil leaves (for garnish) | **Basic Assembly Steps** 1. **Cook the noodles** (if not using no‑boil). Drain and set aside. 2. **Make the meat sauce**: brown the meat with onion & garlic, add tomatoes, broth, seasonings, and simmer 20–30 min. 3. **Prepare ricotta mixture**: beat ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, and nutmeg together. 4. **Layer**: start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta, mozzarella, and repeat until all components are used, finishing with sauce and a generous sprinkle of Parmesan. 5. **Bake**: cover with foil, bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden. 6. **Rest**: let sit 10 min before slicing. Feel free to tweak quantities or add your favorite veggies—lasagna is wonderfully adaptable!
